project: 225 Northwestern Avenue Planned Development; A2013.087; final detailed plans dated 2014-04-30

orientation.basis: A100 north arrow is rotated to the right side of the sheet; long building axis is parallel to north direction. Checked against current orthophoto and retained local campus Y axis.

interpretation: Dimensions are read from proposed 2014 design drawings, not a post-construction survey. A100 gross footprint coverage is smaller than the simple A105 overall rectangle, so the shell outline includes minor recesses/chamfers not represented by the current rectangular massing core.
uncertainty: Plan set identifies proposed project and matches address/use, but later revisions/as-built wall edges may differ. Do not treat eaves or parcel lines as surveyed shell.

model_comparison.upper_shell_note: The model reuses the first-floor 151 ft 6 1/2 in north-south shell length for upper floors; A105 upper-floor length is 151 ft 4 1/2 in, a 2-inch difference. The graded .blend is retained unchanged. The 57 ft 11 in upper-floor width matches A105 within rounding.
